name: DCA Lucky Fortune Cookery Teriyaki Chicken & Steamed White Rice Bowl

prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl; request steamed broccoli served soft or hold broccoli entirely during active flares.
